_comment: Deliberate cross-vocabulary anchors that the mechanical rules would otherwise flag, each with the reason it stands. Read by check-mappings.ts (do not report this assertion) AND by triage-skos-report.ts (an audit panel may not propose changing an entry's relation, and a proposal that lands ON an entry is pre-blessed). Keeping one list for both is what stopped the textile panel from flipping eutex:seasonCollection, whose narrowMatch is intentional: a collection designation aggregates both the season name and its calendar year.

allow.subject: eubat:ThirdPartyVerification
allow.reason: Rejected 2026-08-04 audit proposal (narrowMatch, 0.89): an enumeration of ENERGY STAR rating values is a value list, not a kind of third-party verification record - level confusion per the triage's own type-vs-entity rule.

allow.subject: eubat:BatteryChemistry
allow.reason: Rejected 2026-08-04 audit proposal (broadMatch, 0.94): a battery chemistry names the electrochemical SYSTEM (e.g. LiNMC cell architecture), not a portion of matter of constant composition; asserting subsumption under ChemicalSubstance is a category error.
